title: Closing a project's last session leaves a blank project page with Start a session

requirements.text: Closing the last session of a project on screen shows that project's blank page instead of starting a new session or jumping to another project
The blank page has a Start a session button that starts one in that project; ⌘N does the same
requirements.check: eye: close a project's last session, click Start a session

requirements.text: Opening a project with no sessions (plus menu, dashboard) shows the blank page rather than starting a session
App builds and all tests pass
requirements.check: cd app && swift build && swift test

text: Closing a project's last session no longer starts a fresh one (reverses 9ac2533); it shows a blank project page with Start a session
user_said: closing the last session for a project should bring it to the project page BLANK with 'start as session' vs starting a new session. this is so that the status update doesnt report on empty sessions
